[b][color=#00ff00]Description:[/color][/b]
You’ve heard of Wumbus. Maybe you’ve seen the movies and even read the comics. But have you ever wanted to [i]be[/i] Wumbus?
Well, now you can!

Originally this was meant to be a quick little April Fools joke. Unfortunately, I ended up putting far more effort into it than I probably should have, so now it exists as a fully wearable Wumbus outfit for your farmer.
This mod is a purely aesthetic addition made for the Fashion Sense framework. It does not change the story, gameplay, or mechanics in any way. It simply lets you embrace your inner Wumbus.
I’ve done my best to make the animations work properly across as many situations as possible, but if anything looks a little...[i] strange[/i], feel free to let me know.

[b][color=#00ff00]I've never heard of Fashion Sense, what is it?[/color][/b]
Fashion Sense is a framework mod for Stardew Valley that lets you add and wear custom clothing, hairstyles, accessories, and other appearance options. It’s used by content packs like this one to change how your farmer looks without affecting gameplay.


[b][color=#00ff00]Installation:[/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ is installed.
[*]Extract [FS]WumbusOutfit into your mods folder. It will end up looking like:
[code]StardewValley\Mods\[FS]WumbusOutfit
[/code][*]Launch via SMAPI.

[/list]
